title: Burpless Cucumber - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Early Variety
description:
Grow Your Own Delicious, Easy-to-Digest Cucumbers!


KEY FEATURES
• High-yielding plants producing refreshing, crisp cucumbers.
• Specifically bred for a 'burpless' quality, making them easier to digest.
• Versatile for growing in greenhouses, polytunnels, or sunny outdoor spots.
• Excellent source of hydration due to high water content.
• Mini plug plants provide a strong, healthy start for easier cultivation.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis sativus
Colour: Green (fruit), Yellow (flowers)
Season: Mid-summer to early autumn
Growth Habit: Climbing/Scrambling vine
Flavour: Mild, fresh, crisp, and refreshing with good digestibility.
Time to Harvest: 90-120 days from seed (quicker from plug plants)


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun/Partial shade
Soil: Any well-drained and fertile soil, enriched with compost or well-rotted manure.
Watering: High; consistent moisture is crucial, especially during hot spells. Water at the base of the plant.
Spacing: 30cm (1ft) apart, or in containers at least 30cm (1ft) wide and deep.
Height: Climbing vine, can reach several feet depending on support.
Spread: Spreading vine, can be contained with training.
Hardiness: Tender (do not expose to frost)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in a warm, sheltered spot with plenty of light, either in a greenhouse or outdoors once all danger of frost has passed.
• Prepare the soil by digging in two bucketfuls of compost or well-rotted manure per plant, or use a good quality peat-free multi-purpose compost for containers.
• Ensure consistent watering, keeping the compost evenly moist. Avoid wetting the leaves to prevent fungal diseases.
• Provide sturdy supports for climbing varieties to encourage upward growth and save space.
• Feed regularly with a balanced liquid fertiliser once fruits begin to form, especially for container-grown plants.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
